producer_report.summary: Applied the nine cap values to athena.toml: reader_usd 2.00, producer_usd 10.00, verifier_usd 5.00, planner_usd 3.00, critic_usd 3.00, max_rounds 5, producer_timeout_s 5400, verifier_timeout_s 3600 and job_usd 50.00. The caps require 2 + 5×(3+3) + 10 + 5 = 47.00, and 50.00 covers that. Then I re-pinned every test that read the old values, in test code only: config.rs (plus one new test, the_repository_budget_caps_cover_their_sum), admission.rs, reading.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, run/tests.rs, and athena-cli's job_plan.rs, lifecycle.rs and drain.rs. Drain budgets were raised to 100.0 because read 2 + run 50 does not fit in 50. CHANGELOG.md has a new Changed entry. The athena-data tests, the lifecycle tests and the drain tests pass on their own, clippy is clean, and the policy scan passes. In the one full workspace run, lifecycle.rs's a_killed_invocation_is_recorded_with_bounds failed on a pinned producer cap of 3.0. I fixed it to 10.0 and re-ran lifecycle alone, but did not repeat the full run.

checks_run.note: 157 unit + 3 repo_config tests pass, including the new the_repository_budget_caps_cover_their_sum

One failure, a_killed_invocation_is_recorded_with_bounds (pinned producer cap 3.0). Fixed to 10.0 and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle -q` re-run: 72 pass. Every other target passed in that run (drain 164 passed before the final lifecycle fix, drain re-run alone after the drain edits). Drain and lifecycle edits were made before this run except the one lifecycle cap fix.
applied formatting (not --check); rustfmt reformatted three test files

criteria_check.evidence: 2 + 5*(3+3) + 10 + 5 = 47.00 <= 50.00. the_repository_budget_caps_cover_their_sum asserts it; reading.rs shipped_budget_covers_the_reserve (reserve 47.0, check_budget ok) and the admission tests pass in the workspace run.

open_issues: Scope beyond the five listed deliverables: test-only edits were also needed in reading.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, run/tests.rs, lifecycle.rs and drain.rs, as the plan already stated; no production code changed.
job_plan_defaults_are_off_and_bounded in config.rs was left unchanged on purpose: it reads the code defaults (0.75, 3), not athena.toml.
The final full workspace run was not repeated after the last lifecycle cap fix; I re-ran lifecycle (72 passed) and the other targets were green in the preceding full run.
mistakes: In lifecycle.rs I mis-indented a `.ask(` line while editing; cargo fmt/my follow-up edit corrected it.

I did not read lifecycle.rs's a_killed_invocation_is_recorded_with_bounds before running the workspace, so the first workspace run missed it (it was hidden by the fail-fast stop); found on the second run.
learnings: drain.rs tests in athena-cli call limits(50.0) and plan(.., 2.0/5.0): with run cap 50.00 and read cap 2.00 the drain reserve (read + run = 52) exceeds a 50 budget, so real-steps drains stop with 'budget spent'. I raised those to 100.0 (and plan budgets that read two requests from 2.0 to 4.0).
lifecycle.rs a_killed_invocation_is_recorded_with_bounds pins the producer cap as the cost upper bound (3.0 -> 10.0); the plan did not list it.
`cargo test --workspace` without --no-fail-fast stops after the first failing test binary, so later binaries (lifecycle) did not run in my first attempt.
admission_refuses test in run_pin_tests.rs keeps its explicit 0.75 planner/critic caps appended to the config, so its required sum is 21.50, not 47.00.
desires: A way to run only the previously-failing set of tests across the workspace quickly; the drain and lifecycle test binaries take about two minutes each.
